settings.topology: Eight embedded clients retain independent quotas and bucket ownership on one logical volume backed by eight NVMe members. Only volume-level I/O is modeled.
settings.natural_restore: Use native prefix lookup, leases and BatchEvict. Prefer a memory replica on GET. A disk replica becomes readable on successful bucket publication.

volume.service_model: One bidirectional FIFO. Multiply both single-member directional rates by the selected factor. 4x is an uncalibrated intermediate scenario, 8x is an arithmetic sequential ceiling. No stripe, member LBA, NAND or per-member assignment.

topology.basis: DGX B300 has eight 3.84 TB cache devices and 2 TB default host RAM. DGX OS recommends RAID 0 for data caching. The aggregate 24 TB KV budget and eight independent 3 TB client quotas are study choices.

ssd.basis: Micron 7450 PRO E1.S 3.84 TB Table 1 sequential rates per member, decimal MB/s. These are inputs to the logical volume service scenarios, with no measured array throughput.
